title: Block Goal Tracker
description: lets you pin mining and gathering goals directly on your HUD so you always know how many items you still need. Track multiple tasks at the same time
body:
- /trackblock add <block_id> <amount>
- /trackblock clear
- /trackblock hide 
- /trackblock list
- /trackblock remove <block_id>
- /trackblock show
lets you pin mining and gathering goals directly on your HUD so you always know how many items you still need. Track multiple tasks at the same time, see live progress while collecting resources, and move the HUD from Mod Menu to place it anywhere on your screen.
